results.title: 'Breaking Bad' Actor RJ Mitte Passed Away at 34
results.description: RJ Mitte, the actor who played Walter White's son in 'Breaking Bad,' has died at age 34. Known for his authentic portrayal of a character with cerebral palsy, Mitte was also a dedicated disability rights advocate.
